title: matrix copy: bind the confirmed write to source row content, not only steps

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-131825-4682 for S548 (discovered from S548):

Binding by steps alone misses a change in the content of a source row
`MatrixCopyStep` has only `op`, `id` and `changed` (`internal/daemon/matrixcopy.go:55-59`). Suppose the source row's model is edited between the preview and the write. The target's steps stay the same (`add rNN changed`), so the write passes the check with content the owner never saw. This is how the owner-chosen expect-steps design works, but the changelog says "writes exactly what the owner confirmed" (`landed-changed/S548.md:1`). PLAUSIBLE, from reading the code; not run.
Importance: 1
Urgency: 1
Effort: 2

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestMatrixCopyRefusesAProjectWhoseSourceRowsChangedSinceThePreview` (daemon): a source row's model is edited between preview and write with the steps unchanged; the bound project is refused with CodeStalePreview, nothing is written to it, and the unbound project goes on.
- `TestMatrixCopyWritesAProjectWhoseSourceRowsAreTheOnesPreviewed` (daemon): an unchanged source passes.
- `TestRolesMatrixCopyWriteSendsEachConfirmedProjectsPreviewDigest` (cli): the confirmed write sends the preview's digest, for the confirmed projects only.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): Where does the source row content ride, and is it content or a hash? -> digest: A per-project SHA-256 of the planned rows goes in a new MatrixCopyProject field. The CLI sends it back in a new MatrixCopyParams.ExpectRows map, and checkCopy refuses a mismatch with CodeStalePreview. MatrixCopyStep stays slicer's output shape. [matrix.copy-bind-content]. How should this slice's empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check sections say when it is done? -> tighten: Files are the matrixcopy.go and matrixcopy_test.go files under internal/daemon and the roles.go and roles_matrix_test.go files under internal/cli. Failing tests are a daemon test where a source row's model is edited between preview and write with the steps unchanged (refused with CodeStalePreview, nothing written to that project, other projects go on), a daemon test where an unchanged source passes, and a CLI test that the confirmed write sends the preview's digest. Check is go test ./... exiting 0 with the new tests passing, plus go vet ./... and gofmt -l . clean. The landed-changed/S548.md text gets corrected through slicer changelog add, not by hand..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./...` exits 0 with the new tests passing
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
